title.description: Text in the panel's top bar.

characterName.description: Text at the right of the top bar.

gearSet.description: The row above the job header: a caption, icon links and the job menu.

tabs.description: The content pane's tabs. Without them, only the equipment pane is drawn.

icon.description: Up to 4 characters drawn as the icon.

iconSrc.description: An image drawn as the icon. Wins over icon and iconName.

iconName.description: One of the package's built-in drawings. Used when neither iconSrc nor icon is set.

hidden.description: Kept in the config, never rendered; publicConfig() leaves it out.

blocks.description: The tab's content. A tab has blocks or pages, not both.

pages.description: Sub-tabs, each with its own blocks. A tab has blocks or pages, not both.

id.description: Used in the URL: ?page=<id>. Unique within its tab.

icon.description: Up to 4 characters drawn as the icon.

iconSrc.description: An image drawn as the icon. Wins over icon and iconName.

iconName.description: One of the package's built-in drawings. Used when neither iconSrc nor icon is set.

hidden.description: Kept in the config, never rendered; publicConfig() leaves it out.

id.description: Stable id; jobs fill slots by this id.

label.description: The slot's name, e.g. "Skills". Shown in its tooltip, and under the square on narrow screens.

position.description: left/right: the columns beside the portrait (up to 6 each). header-start/header-end: one slot each, either side of the job name.

icon.description: Up to 4 characters drawn in the square. Defaults to the label's first two letters.

name.description: Short name for the job menu, e.g. "Healthcare".

title.description: The panel heading, e.g. "Developer in healthcare".

status.description: published: on the site. draft (not ready yet) and hidden (taken off the site) leave the job out of the public panel but keep it editable. The default job must be published.

icon.description: Glyph in the job emblem beside the title. Defaults to the name's first two letters.

src.description: Any image URL: Cloudinary, a CMS asset, or a local path.

framing.description: Where the photo is cropped from when it fills the frame. face: kept near the top. full: centered.

badge.description: A figure in the portrait's top corner.

target.description: Element id on the same page, without the #.

href.description: A path on the same site.

newTab.description: Open in a new tab. Off by default.

name.description: A query parameter to set on the current page (keeping ?job=), e.g. "stack". Not "job", "tab" or "page", which the panel uses.

value.description: The value to set it to.

target.description: Element id on the same page to scroll to after, without the #.

iconSrc.description: An image drawn in the square instead of the slot's glyph (decorative; the label names it).

slots.description: Content per slot id. A slot without an entry renders empty.

sections.description: Markdown per page section id. The host page renders these; the panel doesn't.

blocks.description: Block id to a whole block of the same type, shown instead of that shared block for this job.

gearSet.description: Replaces the config's gearSet for this job.

label.description: The job menu button's accessible name. Defaults to "Change job".
